11698.desc: An old book of unknown origin. It tells how to forge an ancient weapon.

11699.desc: An ancient technique guide. Collect enough to raise the Tower Skill cost limit.

11700.desc: Rare ore that shines like the sun. Very brittle: handle with care.

11701.desc: Rumored Black Diablos's mighty shell. So tough that great care is needed.

11702.desc: Fine Black Diablos fang. Its countless scars show many battles survived.

11703.desc: Horn shaped best for gouging the earth. Its twist is truly beyond the ordinary.

11704.desc: A pair of symmetrical black horns. Their twist and rarity enthrall.

11705.desc: Black horn twisted dramatically. Hunters seeing it first reportedly gasp.

11706.desc: Shell of a rare white Monoblos. Its clean white is very popular with women.

11707.desc: Rare white Monoblos back shell. Polish it with care to brighten the white.

11708.desc: Horn from a tough White Monoblos. Its deep white feels elegant and modest.

11709.desc: Horn from a tough White Monoblos. Strength and purity are perfectly mixed.

11710.desc: Hard fang from the stalwart White Monoblos. Its hardness defies common sense.

11711.desc: Rare shell of a tough White Monoblos. Its hardness is used in crafted goods.

11712.desc: Rare shell of a tough White Monoblos. Said to be abnormally hard.

11713.desc: Ticket needed to hunt monsters ahead of their official release.

11714.desc: Blood from monsters that date to ancient times. Full of life.

11715.desc: Hide of a Floating Peak Dragon. Made of unfamiliar tissue; fully stretchy.

11716.desc: Faint hair on the Floating Peak Dragon. It resists blades and won't cut easily.

11717.desc: Scarred, dirty Floating Peak Dragon tooth. Huge, useless unless melted down. Stinks.

11718.desc: Digestive fluid from a Floating Peak Dragon. Dissolves all it touches.

11719.desc: Rare vine on the Floating Peak Dragon. Rumored to feed on its fluid.

11720.desc: Mystery empty seed shell, thought a Dragon Tree seed. Only a shell: unknown.

11721.desc: Floating Peak Dragon hide with more complex tissue and flexibility. Hard to carve.

11722.desc: Thick, supple Floating Peak Dragon fur. Its thickness gives amazing strength.

11723.desc: Dazzlingly shiny Floating Peak Dragon tooth. Study shows it is mostly gold.

11724.desc: Floating Peak Dragon stomach that swallows anything. Thunderbugs breed inside.

11725.desc: Dragon vine soaked in Floating Peak Dragon fluid. Brewed: immortality.

11726.desc: Got a Dragon God Tree seed. A shock makes it grow fast, its tip as sharp as a spear.

11727.desc: Proof of a brave hunter, earned only by those who completed a harsh hunt.

11729.desc: Very tough Abiorugu scale. Half-hearted attacks will damage the weapon instead.

11730.desc: Very tough Abiorugu hide. Excellent stretch, so it is prized as a material.

11731.desc: Very tough Abiorugu horn. Its glittering crimson rouses a fighting spirit.

11732.desc: Blood of a starving Abiorugu. It has turned the color of raging flames.

11733.desc: Abiorugu's sturdy tail. The sharp wavy edge is dangerous: handle with care.

11734.desc: Mighty Abiorugu fang that crushes anything. Said to be extremely hard to work.

11735.desc: Odd-shaped Abiorugu bone. Allows wild moves that a normal one cannot make.

11736.desc: Odd-shaped Abiorugu bone. Allows astounding moves a normal one cannot make.

11737.desc: Odd-shaped Abiorugu bone. Allows earth-shaking moves a normal one cannot make.

11738.desc: Bone of an especially strong Abiorugu. Top-class in hardness and flexibility.

11739.desc: An egg glowing faintly from constant moonlight. No hunter knows what hatches.

11740.desc: Hat said to be worn by the Shakalaka king. How many he had is unknown.

11741.desc: Fur that gleams so white in light it seems noble. Best kept in the dark.

11742.desc: Black fur with a rugged air. Best kept in the dark so sunlight won't fade it.

11743.desc: Vivid, fiery red fur. Popular, so often kept out of sight.

11744.desc: Golden paint that captivates. Said to give weapons surprising power.

11745.desc: Silver paint that captivates. Said to give weapons surprising power.

11746.desc: Copper paint that captivates. Said to give weapons surprising power.

11747.desc: Hardy plant said to grow wild in harsh lands. Its tough fibers make fine gear.

11748.desc: Hardy plant said to grow wild in harsh lands. Its tough fibers make fine gear.

11749.desc: Hardy plant said to grow wild in harsh lands. Its tough fibers make fine gear.

11750.desc: Hardy plant said to grow wild in harsh lands. Its tough fibers make fine gear.

11751.desc: Magnetized white ore. Easily reshaped, but hard to carve or break.

11752.desc: Ore rounded smooth by quicksand. Often used in weapon and armor ornaments.

11753.desc: Bug that rolls bone shards into balls. Its bone nests dot White Lake.

11754.desc: Insect of arid regions. It needs almost no water to live.

11755.desc: Coats itself in nutritious nectar film to eat insects. A great adhesive.

11756.desc: Plant with one big flower that blooms briefly. Seeing it brings luck.

11757.desc: All-white fish. Said to have evolved at White Lake to escape predators.

11758.desc: A stone with a white and brown swirl. It somehow looks delicious.

11759.desc: Smooth rock with white phosphorescence. Tough and heat-proof: hard to work.

11760.desc: Pure white ore shining brightest at White Lake. Beautiful, and quite hard.

11761.desc: Small sand-eating bug. Its clear body and the sand inside are both materials.

11762.desc: Tiny insect long prized as a symbol of a strong heart for its vitality.

11763.desc: Heavy oval cactus full of water. Moderately strong and springy.

11764.desc: Hardy grass that never withers. Lives hundreds of days on a drop of water.

11765.desc: Water plant that purifies water. Woven into fiber, it protects gear from wear.

11766.desc: Mushroom on bedrock, eroding it. The rock merges into the stem and becomes mushroom.

11767.desc: Once big pincers catch prey, they never let go, whatever happens. Handle with care!

11768.desc: A precious fish said to live only in calm, clear water. Hard even to see.
